body:
Real, found-live gap closed: GET /api/v1/identities/me 404'd unconditionally for every local-auth session. Root cause, checked directly: a local-auth JWT's sub is 'local:<uid>', but MeHandler always called h.Store.GetUserByID, which queries the separate users table -- local-auth accounts live in local_users instead (a real, separate projection), and never had a row in users at all. Fixed: MeHandler now branches on a 'local:' prefix, resolving through the same userlog.UserProjector.GetByUID the login handler already uses, building the same real identity/rbac/meta response shape from the real LocalUser row + localUserPermissions. 4 new tests. go build/vet/test clean, gofmt clean. Live-verified end to end against a real, freshly-booted instance (fresh SQLite DB, real register + local login + /me call) -- not just unit tests: the real user's own email/gamertag/status/permissions all came back correctly. This was the real, named, standing blocker on the 'idunapro whoami' CLI subcommand -- that subcommand itself remains real, separate, unbuilt follow-up. README.md and CLAUDE.md both updated to reflect the real fix. Commit e8386bd.

⚓ ☃
title: 9988 (cruise): /api/v1/identities/me now resolves local-auth users for real
